name: Boulder set (three)
brief: MK-098 Boulder set: three basalt boulders (a big cover rock, a medium one and a sitting rock), angular and pitted, each sunk into a low drift of dust where it landed. Each has its own mass, so the small one can be shoved in low gravity and the big one stops a gem bug.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
